title: FLUX.1-dev Text-to-Image
description: Serverless FLUX.1-dev (bf16) worker: prompt in, base64 PNG/JPEG out. Validates input, enforces a prompt blocklist, snaps dimensions to multiples of 16, always echoes the seed, reports progress at ~10% strides, returns structured error envelopes. 2.9GB image; weights arrive via RunPod's cached models.

input.name: Model ID
input.description: HuggingFace repository the weights come from. Must match the endpoint's Model field (cached models).

input.name: Model revision
input.description: Reported, not pinned: discovered from the staged snapshot at load. Set only for weight layouts carrying no revision evidence.

input.name: Weights path
input.description: Explicit diffusers-layout directory (baked image or mounted volume). When the path does not exist the worker falls through to the model cache — leave as-is on a cached-models endpoint.

input.name: Model cache root
input.description: HuggingFace hub cache directory where RunPod stages the cached model. Used only when WEIGHTS_PATH is absent.
